results.title: 2015 BMW M235i Convertible 6-Speed at No Reserve
results.description: This 2015 BMW M235i convertible is finished in Mineral Gray Metallic over Black SensaTec and is powered by a turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-six paired with a six-speed manual transmission. Equipment includes the Lighting Package, 18" Style 436M alloy wheels, an adaptive M suspension, variable sport steering, M Sport brakes, adaptive xenon headlights, a power-operated convertible soft top, Park Distance Control, a rearview camera, front sport seats, a Harman Kardon sound system, automatic climate control, cruise control, and iDrive infotainment with navigation. The car remained registered in Texas from new until 2023 and now has 86k miles. This F23 is now offered by the selling dealer at no reserve with the owner's manual, a clean Carfax report, and a clean Pennsylvania title.
